body: Source review of plan0d4d3478 found two blocking contract ambiguities. Please revise plan source-only: (1) requestSaveClose shared durability outcome must be saved or failed and identical for all joiners; superseded belongs only to per-caller action dispatch, never the shared close result. (2) Quit can finish Develop close then encounter Document veto; define decision ordering or explicit owner-checked reopen/restore after later veto so Cancel Quit leaves prior editing destination usable, with deterministic test. Also specify exactly-once per-openFolder request callback ownership on cancellation/supersession (current generation guard silently drops then), and concrete owner/target/edit-generation reservation held through actual output capture/start, not a recheck followed by async gap. No product edits or workloads. Preserve B hold and paused heartbeat. Publish revised plan and result; A Core implementation proceeds separately.
